title: Local Vegetables for Every Lunch
locale: 山口県公立高校入試型
sentences: Our school decided to use more locally grown vegetables in its lunches, and the student council was asked to study the plan.
The kitchen needed sixty kilograms of vegetables on each lunch day, but nearby farms could not always provide that amount.
A delivery table showed that one farm could bring forty kilograms on Monday, fifty-five on Wednesday, and only thirty on Friday.
Another farm offered twenty kilograms on Monday and thirty on Friday, but it had no delivery available on Wednesday.
Ken added the Monday amounts and said the kitchen could receive enough without ordering from outside the town.
The two Monday deliveries totaled exactly sixty, and the two Friday deliveries did too, which made the plan look promising.
Mika pointed out that Wednesday was different, because only fifty-five kilograms could arrive from the farms on our list.
The school manager explained that lunch quantities had to be reliable, and the kitchen could not simply serve less food.
Our group proposed using local vegetables when sufficient amounts were confirmed, while keeping another supplier for a possible shortage.
We asked whether the menu could change by season because farmers grew different vegetables during the warm and cold months.
The manager said some recipes were flexible, but every change still needed careful checks of cost, nutrition, and food safety.
A farmer told us that heavy rain might delay delivery trucks, even when vegetables had already been harvested.
We therefore suggested confirming each order the day before and giving the kitchen an early message if a delivery might arrive late.
Ken wanted to write that local food was always cheaper and better, but our teacher asked him to check the evidence.
The price table showed some local items were cheaper, while others cost more, so the word always would have been misleading.
At the next meeting, we prepared a report explaining which days had enough supplies and which day needed an additional source.
We included a simple rule for checking deliveries before the kitchen started cooking, rather than relying only on the original plan.
The manager agreed to try the arrangement for one month, while collecting information about reliability and cost.
Mika said the best result would not be the largest number of local boxes, but a lunch plan that students could depend on.
I realized that supporting local farmers and meeting students' needs were goals that required careful planning together.
Our final report did not promise a perfect solution, but it showed how numbers and flexible decisions could make the project more reliable.
fullTranslation:
私たちの学校は給食に地元の野菜を増やすことにし、生徒会がその計画を調べることになりました。
給食室は毎日六十キロの野菜を必要としていましたが、地元農家が毎回その量を供給できるわけではありませんでした。
一つの農家の納品予定は月曜四十キロ、水曜五十五キロ、金曜三十キロでした。
別の農家は月曜二十キロ、金曜三十キロを供給できますが、水曜は納品できませんでした。
ケンは月曜の二つの農家の量を足し、町外に注文せず必要量を確保できると話しました。
月曜と金曜の二つの農家からの納品はそれぞれ合計六十キロで、計画は有望に見えました。
ミカは水曜日は一覧の農家から五十五キロしか届かないことを指摘しました。
学校の責任者は給食の量を安定して確保する必要があり、単純に食事を減らすことはできないと話しました。
私たちは地元の量を確保できた日は活用し、不足に備えた別の仕入先も維持する案を出しました。
また、季節によって育つ野菜が変わるため、献立の調整もできないかと相談しました。
責任者は一部の献立は調整できるものの、費用、栄養、食品安全の確認は不可欠だと説明しました。
農家は野菜を収穫していても、大雨で配送車が遅れる場合があると話しました。
そのため私たちは前日に注文を確認し、遅延の可能性があれば早めに給食室へ知らせる案を考えました。
ケンは地元産は常に安く優れていると書こうとしましたが、先生は根拠を確認するよう求めました。
価格表では地元産が安い品も高い品もあり、「いつも」という表現は適切ではありませんでした。
次の会議で、十分供給できる曜日と追加仕入れが必要な曜日を説明する報告を作りました。
私たちは最初の計画だけに頼らず、調理前に納品状況を確認する手順を示しました。
責任者は一か月間、納品の確実さと費用を記録しながら試すことに同意しました。
ミカは地元産の箱をただ増やすことより、安心して提供できる給食が大切だと話しました。
私は地元農家を支援することと、生徒の必要を満たすことを両立する慎重な計画が必要だと学びました。
最終報告は完璧を約束せず、数字と柔軟な判断によって計画の確実性を高められることを示しました。

materials.title: Possible vegetable delivery by two local farms
materials.note: All amounts are proposals, not guaranteed deliveries. Menu changes require nutrition, cost and safety checks.

questions.prompt: How many kilograms of vegetables did the kitchen need each day?
questions.evidence: The kitchen needed sixty kilograms of vegetables on each lunch day, but nearby farms could not always provide that amount.
questions.evidenceJp: 給食室は毎日六十キロの野菜を必要としていましたが、地元農家が毎回その量を供給できるわけではありませんでした。

questions.prompt: Which day lacked enough local vegetables on the current plan?
questions.evidence: Mika pointed out that Wednesday was different, because only fifty-five kilograms could arrive from the farms on our list.
questions.evidenceJp: ミカは水曜日は一覧の農家から五十五キロしか届かないことを指摘しました。

questions.prompt: Why could the kitchen not simply accept a lower amount?
questions.answer: The school had to provide reliable lunch quantities.
questions.evidence: The school manager explained that lunch quantities had to be reliable, and the kitchen could not simply serve less food.
questions.evidenceJp: 学校の責任者は給食の量を安定して確保する必要があり、単純に食事を減らすことはできないと話しました。
questions.reason: 給食量を安定確保する必要があるため。

questions.prompt: Choose the true statement: A Farm B delivered on Wednesday; B Farm B offered thirty kilograms Friday; C Farm A offered sixty Monday; D Farm A offered thirty Wednesday.
questions.evidence: Another farm offered twenty kilograms on Monday and thirty on Friday, but it had no delivery available on Wednesday.
questions.evidenceJp: 別の農家は月曜二十キロ、金曜三十キロを供給できますが、水曜は納品できませんでした。

questions.prompt: Why did Mika value reliability more than simply counting local boxes?
questions.answer: Students needed dependable lunches, not just a higher local-food total.
questions.evidence: Mika said the best result would not be the largest number of local boxes, but a lunch plan that students could depend on.
questions.evidenceJp: ミカは地元産の箱をただ増やすことより、安心して提供できる給食が大切だと話しました。
questions.reason: 給食そのものの確実性を優先すべきだから。

questionSetB.prompt: Where should 'This would give the kitchen time to change its plan.' fit best: after sentence 4, 9, 13, or 19?
questionSetB.evidence: We therefore suggested confirming each order the day before and giving the kitchen an early message if a delivery might arrive late.
questionSetB.evidenceJp: そのため私たちは前日に注文を確認し、遅延の可能性があれば早めに給食室へ知らせる案を考えました。
questionSetB.reason: 遅延を早めに知らせる仕組みを受ける。

questionSetB.prompt: Complete: Wednesday needed an additional _____ to cover the shortage.
questionSetB.evidence: At the next meeting, we prepared a report explaining which days had enough supplies and which day needed an additional source.
questionSetB.evidenceJp: 次の会議で、十分供給できる曜日と追加仕入れが必要な曜日を説明する報告を作りました。
questionSetB.reason: 別の仕入先を追加するという要点をまとめる。

questionSetB.prompt: Complete the word: The word a______ would be misleading because prices differed.
questionSetB.evidence: The price table showed some local items were cheaper, while others cost more, so the word always would have been misleading.
questionSetB.evidenceJp: 価格表では地元産が安い品も高い品もあり、「いつも」という表現は適切ではありませんでした。

questionSetB.prompt: How many kilograms were missing on Wednesday?
questionSetB.evidence: Mika pointed out that Wednesday was different, because only fifty-five kilograms could arrive from the farms on our list.
questionSetB.evidenceJp: ミカは水曜日は一覧の農家から五十五キロしか届かないことを指摘しました。

questionSetB.prompt: What is the main idea? A Local supplies are always cheaper; B Dependable planning balances local support, safety and quantities; C One supplier always provides enough; D Weather never changes deliveries.
questionSetB.evidence: Our final report did not promise a perfect solution, but it showed how numbers and flexible decisions could make the project more reliable.
questionSetB.evidenceJp: 最終報告は完璧を約束せず、数字と柔軟な判断によって計画の確実性を高められることを示しました。
questionSetB.reason: 地元支援と安定供給を両立する姿勢。
